info.title: Native Vault Sync HTTP API
info.description: Independent compatible personal server, not an official public Obsidian API. Documents implementation baseline 5159ae5. Session tokens are JSON-body fields; security: [] does not imply account routes are unauthenticated. HTTP 200 may contain an error member. OPTIONS preflight returns 204 after approved Origin checks; headers permit GET,POST,OPTIONS and Content-Type. Allowed origins: app://obsidian.md, literal null, configured public origin, or no Origin. Unknown authenticated POST routes return 501; unrecognized JSON members are ignored. No signup, REST admin, sharing, migration or billing. WebSocket framing is specified separately.

get.summary: Upgrade to the native Sync WebSocket
get.description: Requires standard WebSocket upgrade headers; no application subprotocol or compression. A successful HTTP 101 is followed by a JSON init message containing token, vault ID, keyhash, encryption version and cursor. See docs/API-REFERENCE.md for notifications, binary pieces and sequencing. Do not treat this operation as a JSON REST request.
